title.narrative: Voluntary medical project for burns, deformities and plastic surgery - Yemen

description.narrative: 1- Providing medical services to beneficiaries with limited income who cannot cover the costs of their treatment. 2- Performing specialized surgeries. 3- Providing patients with medication needs as needed. 4- Alleviating the suffering of many patients who need surgical intervention. 5- Health education for everyone receiving treatment for prevention. 6- Assisting the Ministry of Health in the host country that suffers from a shortage of medical staff.
Providing medical services to beneficiaries with limited income who cannot cover the costs of their treatment in the specialty of burns, deformities and plastic surgery.
